rule: ruling:sam-2026-10-07 claims 8, 10 and 11: the prototype wins by default and only a real constraint it cannot express, such as cross-service behaviour, overrides it. DR2.1's '#' plants links are a placeholder for exactly that kind of constraint, because no plants service feeds the prototype. So the real service follows the pattern DR2.1 itself sets for every real section, with glance cards linking to the category-filtered drill-downs (prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-024, trace p1-028/029/031). What remains is waiting on another team, not a design choice.
outcome: The plants section's glance cards link like the live-animals and germinal-products ones. 'View tasks' goes to /actions?category=plants, 'View updates' to /changes?category=plants and 'View requirements' to the Inspection required drill-down at /inspection, so users can reach that page. The '#' links are DR2.1 placeholders for a cross-service flow the prototype cannot express, not a design to copy. The cards' counts, and the cards themselves, are built with the plants section once plants notifications reach the INS read model.
blocker: The plants services (trade-imports-plants-frontend and trade-imports-plants-backend, outside this programme's repos) must publish their notifications to the INS read model in trade-imports-ins-backend before the plants glance cards can count or list anything.
